lessons.text: Don't give the same person heavy and very heavy jobs back to back. Put a light or moderate job between them so they can level off.
Give new hires like Kofi lighter jobs in their first hours. Avoid stacking very heavy shop equipment repair right after pipe insulation for them.
For new hires, expect hard work to wear on them faster than on seasoned crew, and plan their day to match.
